_README: Single source of truth for API test data. Edit values here, then run `npm run build:postman` to regenerate the Postman collection. The Playwright tests read this file directly, so both tools always use the same data. The special value {{timestamp}} is replaced at runtime: Playwright uses Date.now(), Postman uses its built-in {{$timestamp}} dynamic variable.
